high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Google Gemini App, posted 5 hours ago at 11:05 AM. The tweet announces an update to the Gemini app, which introduces a new feature allowing Gemini to learn from past conversations over time. The tweet includes the following text: "We're introducing a new setting that allows Gemini to learn from your past conversations over time. When this setting is on, Gemini remembers key details and preferences you've shared, leading to more natural and relevant conversations, as if you're collaborating with a partner who's already up to speed.
